profile_text.body:
Writer is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as an enterprise AI agent platform built to help teams execute and scale on-brand, compliant work, and says it is trusted by Fortune 500 companies. Its site emphasizes a five-year track record of AI research and large language model innovation, with a stated focus on transparency, reliability, and control for enterprise customers.

The company's primary product, Writer.com, sits in the writing and editing category and encompasses enterprise writing AI, brand governance, style guide enforcement, hallucination detection, and the company's own PALMYRA family of language models. Writer also offers certifications, self-paced courses, and video tutorials covering generative AI fundamentals and custom AI agent development, and positions workflows around enterprise marketing use cases including brand integrity and approval compression.

The held facts note no litigation or MCP server presence on record, and no SEC or patent filings are listed in the available data.
